reason: Maintainer (wolfv) has raised a critical correctness concern: the migration incorrectly maps the linux-amd64 upstream binary archive to the linux-riscv64 platform, which would publish a mislabeled x86-64 package as riscv64. CI passes only because the recipe selects the wrong architecture binary without failing. The maintainer explicitly argues the PR should not be merged until a genuine riscv64 artifact or cross-compiler is available upstream.
